headline: New Delhi Television Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting
sum: Outcome of Board Meeting - New Delhi Television Limited has submitted to the Exchange regarding the un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and…
detail: Outcome of Board Meeting - New Delhi Television Limited has submitted to the Exchange regarding the un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and Raising of funds through the issuance of unsecured, non-convertible perpetual debentures for an amount not exceeding Rs. 800 crores on private placement basis, in one or more tranche(s), subject to such regulatory or statutory approvals, as may be required.
